text: dsh-anime-theme 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 提供以《进击的巨人》《死神》《Re:Zero》和《紫罗兰永恒花园》为灵感的暗色装饰主题。插件通过桌面端的 webserver/index-inject 注入脚本，并通过 Web profile 的 tapIndex 将样式和页面装饰加入界面。主题默认启用，包含渐变顶线、暗角、巨人剪影、飘落花瓣、卍角标、自由之翼徽记和人物海报；系统开启减少动态效果时会跳过花瓣与信笺动画。用户可放入自己的壁纸或海报图片替换内置图案。适合希望为 DSH 网页界面添加动漫风格装饰的用户；代码未读取外部服务或要求 API 密钥。

dsh-anime-theme adds an anime-inspired dark look to the DSH Web GUI. It injects styles and decorations through desktop index-inject and Web tapIndex, with a vignette, titan silhouettes, petals, corner marks and a portrait poster. It starts enabled and supports personal wallpaper images.
想给 DSH 网页界面换成动漫风格的暗色装饰。
Can I add an anime-inspired dark look to the DSH Web GUI?
我想在 DSH 页面背景加入自己的壁纸和人物海报。
dsh-anime-theme 的功能「动漫风格页面装饰」：在 DSH 桌面端或 Web profile 页面注入暗色背景与动漫主题装饰，包括剪影、标记和人物海报；启用减少动态效果时不生成花瓣及信笺动画。插件安装后默认启用。

text:
dsh-anime-theme README · Introduction：A cinematic dark skin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that blends four anime into one cohesive look: Attack on Titan, Bleach, Re:Zero and Violet Evergarden.
一个为 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 打造的电影感暗色皮肤，把四部番剧融进同一套视觉：进击的巨人、死神、Re:Zero 与紫罗兰永恒花园。 ---

dsh-anime-theme README · Features：- **Attack on Titan** — Survey Corps crimson `#d83a30`, a Wings-of-Freedom emblem, and Colossal / Armored / Cart titan ghost silhouettes drifting across the bottom.
- **Bleach** — ink-black ground, bone-white text, spiritual orange, 卍 bankai corner marks and a 「卍解」 wordmark.
- **Re:Zero** — Emilia's amethyst and Rem's azure in the brand gradient.
- **Violet Evergarden** — teal / gold / emerald accents, a framed portrait poster, letters drifting on the wind, serif headings.
- Glass panels, gradient top hairline, ink-wash sidebar with a crimson active rail, unified typography.
- Optional wallpaper and portrait behind a dark wash, honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Two variants**: 夜 (dark) and 昼 (light, warm paper + ink) — click the DSH wordmark to switch, the choice is remembered.

dsh-anime-theme README · Features：
- **进击的巨人** — 调查兵团猩红 `#d83a30`、自由之翼徽记，以及横穿底部的超大型 / 铠之 / 车力巨人幽灵剪影。 - **死神** — 墨黑底、骨白字、灵压橙、四角卍解标记，以及右上角「深 DSH」字标。 - **Re:Zero** — 爱蜜莉雅紫水晶与蕾姆湛蓝，融进品牌渐变。 - **紫罗兰永恒花园** — 青绿 / 金 / 祖母绿点缀、金框人物海报、随风飘过的信笺、衬线标题。 - 玻璃面板、顶部渐变细线、水墨侧栏与猩红选中条、全站统一字体。 - 可换壁纸与人物图（暗色蒙层之下）、尊重「减少动态效果」设置。 - **两套变体**：夜（深色）与昼（浅色，暖纸 + 墨字），点左下角 DSH 字标即可切换，选择会被记住。 ---

dsh-anime-theme README · Install：Requires **DeepSeek Harness ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2, < 0.2.2-0**. Works on the Desktop app and the plain Web profile.

**Plugin market** — pick a custom registry and install by package name `dsh-anime-theme`.

**DSH CLI**

```console
dsh plugin --profile desktop add Incredible-Jian/dsh-Bleach-Violet-Evergarden-Re-Zero-AoT-Themes

dsh-anime-theme README · or from a local clone:：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-anime-theme
```

**Local bundle** — clone the repo anywhere and install the bundle from its absolute directory.

⚠️ **Restart the Desktop app once after installing.** The desktop shell collects page-injection rows at boot and caches them, so a plain refresh will not load a newly installed injection plugin.console
dsh plugin --profile desktop add Incredible-Jian/dsh-Bleach-Violet-Evergarden-Re-Zero-AoT-Themes

dsh-anime-theme README · 或者从本地克隆安装：：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-anime-theme
```

**本地 bundle** — 克隆到任意位置，再按绝对目录安装 bundle。

⚠️ **安装后请重启一次桌面应用。** 桌面端在启动时一次性收集页面注入项并缓存，单纯刷新页面不会加载新装的注入插件。

---

dsh-anime-theme README · Usage：- The theme is on by default once installed. - The skin has a single dark look — there is no switch to operate; the 深 DSH wordmark is purely decorative. - To remove the skin, disable or uninstall the `dsh-anime-theme` row in the Plugins page.
- 安装后主题默认开启。 - 整套皮肤只有一种深色外观，无需切换；顶部中间的 **深 DSH** 字标仅为装饰。 - 想彻底移除：在插件页禁用或卸载 `dsh-anime-theme` 这一行。 ---
dsh-anime-theme README · Customize：All colours live at the top of [`theme.css`](theme.css) inside `html.dsh-anime { … }`.

dsh-anime-theme README · Customize：| Variable | Role | | --- | --- | | `--anime-crimson` / `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` | primary accent | | `--anime-amethyst` / `--anime-azure` | Re:Zero purple / blue | | `--anime-teal` / `--anime-gold` / `--anime-emerald` | Violet Evergarden accents | | `--anime-amber` | Bleach spiritual orange | | `--dsw-alias-bg-base` / `-layer-1` / `-layer-2` | surface depths | | `--anime-font` / `--anime-mono` | UI font / code font |

dsh-anime-theme README · Customize：所有颜色都在 [`theme.css`](theme.css) 顶部的 `html.dsh-anime { … }` 里，改完保存、重启即可。

| 变量 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `--anime-crimson` / `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` | 主强调色 |
| `--anime-amethyst` / `--anime-azure` | Re:Zero 紫 / 蓝 |
| `--anime-teal` / `--anime-gold` / `--anime-emerald` | 紫罗兰永恒花园点缀 |
| `--anime-amber` | 死神灵压橙 |
| `--dsw-alias-bg-base` / `-layer-1` / `-layer-2` | 三层背景深浅 |
| `--anime-font` / `--anime-mono` | 界面字体 / 代码字体 |

dsh-anime-theme README · Wallpaper：The plugin ships an original monochrome “reiatsu” backdrop. To use your own picture, save it as `assets/background.jpg` and restart DSH — it is read at startup, inlined as a data URI and placed under the dark wash.

```console
cp ~/Pictures/my-wallpaper.jpg <path-to-plugin>/assets/background.jpg
```

`assets/background.jpg` is git-ignored, so a private wallpaper is never published with the repo.

dsh-anime-theme README · Wallpaper：The framed poster works the same way: drop a square portrait in as `assets/poster.jpg` and it replaces the drawn Violet SVG. Because the full-canvas wallpaper normally sits behind DSH's opaque shell, the same picture is also hung as a **framed wall-art mural** in the bottom-right decoration column — so it is always visible.
插件自带一张原创的黑白「灵压」壁纸。想换成自己的图，把图片保存为 `assets/background.jpg` 再重启 DSH 即可：启动时读取、内联为 data URI，并压上暗色蒙层。右下角的人物海报同理——把方形人像存成 `assets/poster.jpg`，就会替换掉内置的手绘 SVG。

dsh-anime-theme README · Wallpaper：由于整张壁纸通常会被 DSH 自己的外壳挡住，同一张图还会以**装饰壁画**（带画框）的形式挂在右下角装饰区，保证永远看得见。

```console
cp ~/Pictures/my-wallpaper.jpg <插件目录>/assets/background.jpg
```

`assets/background.jpg` 与 `assets/poster.jpg` 都已加入 `.gitignore`，个人壁纸与人像不会随仓库发布。

dsh-anime-theme README · How it works：A **host-only** plugin. On startup [`index.js`](index.js) reads `theme.css` + `theme.js`, bundles them into one self-contained inline script, and injects it through DSH's `webserver/index-inject` channel (Desktop) and `tapIndex` (plain Web). Every style is scoped under `html.dsh-anime`, so the toggle is instant and the default theme is untouched. No build step, no client bundle.

dsh-anime-theme README · How it works：``` dsh-anime-theme/ ├── index.js # host entry: builds + injects the inline script ├── theme.css # all styling, scoped under html.dsh-anime ├── theme.js # vignette, titans, petals, 卍 corners, poster, toggle
一个**纯宿主**插件。启动时 [`index.js`](index.js) 读取 `theme.css` + `theme.js`，打包成一段自包含的内联脚本，通过 DSH 的 `webserver/index-inject` 通道（桌面端）与 `tapIndex`（纯 Web 端）注入页面。所有样式都收敛在 `html.dsh-anime` 类下，开关瞬时生效，不影响默认主题。无需构建、无客户端 bundle。 ---

dsh-anime-theme README · Compatibility：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.2-0` (tested on `0.2.1-rc.3` Desktop). - The Desktop app needs a restart after install or edits; the Web profile picks changes up on refresh. - Pure CSS/JS — no native binaries, no network calls at runtime.
- 适用 DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.2-0`（已在 `0.2.1-rc.3` 桌面端实测）。 - 桌面端安装或修改后需要重启；Web profile 刷新即可。 - 纯 CSS/JS，无原生二进制、运行时无网络请求。 ---

dsh-anime-theme README · Disclaimer：An **unofficial fan-made theme**. It is inspired by the colour palettes and motifs of Attack on Titan, Bleach, Re:Zero and Violet Evergarden, and contains no copyrighted artwork, logos, fonts, audio or video from those series — the titan silhouettes, wings emblem, sakura and portrait are original SVG shapes drawn for this project.
